items.title: Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Exploitation Tied to Volt Typhoon’s ‘Silent Train’ Network
items.description: Cisco Talos linked SD-WAN key-stealing malware to infrastructure overlapping Volt Typhoon’s Silent Train network, which Lumen detailed. The post Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Exploitation Tied to Volt Typhoon’s ‘Silent Train’ Network appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Shadowy AI Relay Disables OpenAI Codex, Claude Code Sandboxes
items.description: The enigmatic service is providing popular AI coding tools to mainland China and other regions where OpenAI and Anthropic products are not officially for sale — but with key security features turned off.

items.title: Attackers Exploit Second Cisco Firewall VPN Zero-Day Since August
items.description: An exploited flaw in the Remote Access SSL VPN service lets unauthenticated attackers remotely force ASA and FTD firewalls to reload. The post Attackers Exploit Second Cisco Firewall VPN Zero-Day Since August appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: HHS Filing Puts iRhythm Data Breach Toll at 8.2 Million
items.description: Hackers stole personal information and iRhythm account and device data from third-party-hosted business applications. The post HHS Filing Puts iRhythm Data Breach Toll at 8.2 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Hackers Exploited Cisco SD-WAN Flaw to Plant Malware Built to Steal Encryption Keys
items.description: Hackers exploited a critical Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN flaw, fixed in February, to plant custom malware inside the systems that control an organization's SD-WAN network. The malware, called KeyDrift, is designed to copy the keys that encrypt traffic between sites and store them for later use, Cisco Talos said on October 28. items.title: Chinese Hackers Quietly Used Low-Severity ESXi Logging Flaw as Zero-Day
items.description: CVE-2026-41709 allows attackers with administrative privileges to perform operations without being logged. The post Chinese Hackers Quietly Used Low-Severity ESXi Logging Flaw as Zero-Day appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Cyber Vulnerabilities Besiege Italy, Absent Clear Cause
items.description: Researchers can't quite explain why cyber threats look so different in Italy compared to everywhere else.
